purpose: confirm right after deployment that the critical user journeys work in production
entry_criteria: Smoke checks are defined and safe to run in production
procedure: Run read-only or safely reversible checks for each critical journey with test accounts.
Compare key metrics with the pre-deployment baseline.
Check logs for new error types.
Record result per journey as PASS or FAIL with evidence.
On any critical failure trigger rollback per plan.
Report outcome to the release manager and keep watch through the observation window.
acceptance_criteria: All critical journeys pass or rollback was triggered
No new error class in logs
validation_method: Rerun of the failed check after any fix.

validation.command: curl -fsS https://app.example.com/healthz   # example; replace with the real health URL

validation.check: complete login and one read-only purchase-history view with the test account

failure_modes.response: Use dedicated test accounts and cleanup

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: After release, login, search and order history each respond within normal latency; the error rate matches the baseline for fifteen minutes.
